placements.title: organizational authority over what knowledge is retained and what is discarded
placements.frame: What knowledge does the organization direct its agents to hold, and what to forget — and through what protocol mechanism?

placements.title: knowledge disposal by bare imperative
placements.frame: When does a speaker command erasure of specific knowledge as a protocol step — and what does the bare imperative form signal about the authority exercised over what is known?
placements.why: Both segments are imperative directives commanding removal of specific knowledge (the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts; all zeppelin routes). The thematic subject — knowledge erasure performed as a protocol directive — is a container future envelopes could feed if more forget/remove directives appear. No existing leaf holds this theme; the grain test admits it as a subject, not a fact, because it names a recurring practice rather than a one-time event.
